summary: Google DeepMind released WeatherNext 3, an updated global weather forecasting AI model that ingests real-time satellite data for hourly, higher-resolution forecasts, now integrated into Search, Gemini, Maps and Cloud.

practices.reason: The document describes a CRPS-based evaluation methodology against independent ground-truth datasets (IMERG, MRMS, rain gauges) that illustrates a transferable approach to benchmarking probabilistic forecasts, though it is domain-specific to weather.
practices.quote: evaluations against baselines show a Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) improvement of up to 60% against IMERG, 30% for MRMS, and 10% against rain gauge measurements for early lead times
